subject: FACTORY paragraph
notes: Rule (cite.py --check 11.4.4 "implemented by the factory object of the containing class according to 9.3.11" -> OK §11.4.4 1)): the IMPLEMENTS clause names the interfaces the FACTORY object implements per §9.3.11. Code: Build's CaptureImplements records the FACTORY paragraph's list into sym.FactoryImplements (separate from the OBJECT list); ImplementsClosure(cls, factory:true) is consumed by the §9.3.11 conformance pass (factory roster via FindFactoryMethod) and by the emitter (StorageFormPass ~l.121) so the factory singleton's C# type carries the interface. Probes: p6 SET an interface-typed ref TO the class (factory object) and INVOKE through it dispatches the factory method (J-F 0042); golden oo_implements_repeated shows factory and instance each dispatching their own SPEAK through one interface reference (FACTORY SPEAKS / OBJECT SPEAKS); pb389_object_reference_descriptor also exercises FACTORY IMPLEMENTS dispatch. || Editions (adjudicator, verbatim): 2002, 2014, 2023 (OO - the FACTORY paragraph - is new in ISO/IEC 1989:2002; absent from 1985; Annex E of 2023 lists no change to §11.4)
